About

A trip to Ibn Battuta Mall becomes even more delightful with a visit to Cutting Edge Hair Lounge, where beauty meets relaxation. This top-rated salon specializes in a variety of services, from manicures and pedicures to rejuvenating hair treatments and soothing massages. Guests can indulge in a complete beauty experience, perfect for refreshing themselves amidst a bustling shopping day.
